listing.name: Syphon Filter 2 / Syphon Filter 2 Recompiled
listing.summary: Explore Syphon Filter 2 / Syphon Filter 2 Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Run the reviewed upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows owned-input setup kit to an ASCII path without spaces, such as C:\SF2Kit. Place your own SCUS-94451 Disc 1 CUE/BIN beside the kit; Disc 2 may also be present. Run SETUP.bat yourself. It downloads verified pinned tools, builds locally and opens the launcher. Downloading through Portcove does not run setup.

steps.title: Use the generated launcher
steps.instruction: Use the generated play.bat for later starts. It sets required runtime environment variables and passes the private game configuration, disc and memory-card paths. Selecting the native executable alone does not reproduce that supported invocation; keep using play.bat outside Portcove.

steps.title: Keep setup and progress together
steps.instruction: The upstream launcher owns disc selection, video, controls and memory cards. Review setup.log if setup fails. Keep the complete kit and generated files; upstream owns updates and these external files stay outside Portcove backups. Portcove does not currently reproduce this batch launcher contract.
